description: A function named with :: isn't called by its last part alone
notes: The README doesn't say what a function name may be, so an implementation could reject the label ns::f, which isn't an identifier (see native/user-functions/name-with-space-is-not-error), with a schema error. hashicorp/hcl declares the function under the label as written (decodeUserFunctions in ext/userfunc/decode.go), and f() doesn't call a function named ns::f (see native/functions/namespaced-function-is-not-plain-function).
